name: pyautogui_keyboard_press
description:
Press one or more keys. For a single key, pass a string (e.g. "enter", "escape", "f5"). For a key combination (hotkey), pass an array (e.g. ["ctrl", "c"]). Use `presses` to repeat a single key multiple times.

Key names follow xdotool conventions: enter, escape, tab, space, backspace, delete, up, down, left, right, f1–f12, ctrl, alt, shift, super, etc.

keys.description: Key name (string) or list of keys for a hotkey (array of strings)

presses.description: Repeat count for a single key (default 1)
